title: Adam Wedd gears up for an unforgettable ride with "Pedal to the Metal"
htmlContent: Adam Wedd's latest single, "Pedal to the Metal," is the perfect song for hitting the open road with friends, feeling the breeze, and embracing the fun of summer. This track captures the carefree spirit we all love, making it a track for those memorable road trips. The story behind "Pedal to the Metal" is as genuine as the song. It came to life on a summer day spent with his friend Leo, where they enjoyed good times and drinks. Inspired by that relaxed vibe, Adam created a catchy and energetic track that makes you want to roll down the windows, step on the gas, and let the music lead the way. The song was recorded in various locations, including the lively Finsbury Park and the creative Unit 13 Studio in Bermondsey. Each place added its own charm to the music, making it a true reflection of Adam's dedication and passion for crafting something special. The collaboration with friends brought an extra spark to the song, giving it a lively personality. "Pedal to the Metal" is a sneak peek of what's coming in Adam Wedd's upcoming EP, titled "Merchant Man," which is set to be released in May 2025. This upbeat single hints at the exciting musical journey that fans can look forward to in the full EP. https://open.spotify.com/track/3UGv9xHzZG8EjKWjBHToW1 Adam Wedd wants to share experiences that invite everyone to join in the fun. So turn up the volume, and let "Pedal to the Metal" take you on an unforgettable road trip. With Adam Wedd leading the way, this adventure will surely be thrilling. "Pedal to the Metal" is available now, and don't forget to mark your calendars for the "Merchant Man" EP coming in May 2025. There's much more to come, so stay tuned for this exciting musical journey. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
